Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a synergistic strategy combining oxygen vacancies, spinel phase, and TiF₄ coating to stabilize localized O₂ⁿ⁻ in Li-rich cathodes. This interface reconstruction suppresses oxygen release and side reactions while enabling 3D Li⁺ diffusion. item.title: Facet‐Regulated MOF Nanosheets Enable Ion‐Selective Separators for Stable Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

SmartMat | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Facet engineering of MOF nanosheets yields ion-selective separators for lithium metal batteries. Gluconate anions adsorb on high-energy facets, suppressing vertical growth to form ultrathin Zn(bim)(OAc) nanosheets. Coated on polypropylene, they anchor anions and boost Li⁺ transference (0.73), suppressing dendrites over 1000 h and retaining 85% capacity after 500 cycles. This offers a general strategy for stable lithium metal batteries.

item.title: A Universal Spin‐Polarization‐Engineered Antibonding‐Orbital Modulation Paradigm for Accelerating Reaction Kinetics in Ultrahigh‐Rate Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله با مهندسی قطبش اسپینی و تنظیم اوربیتال آنتیباندینگ، سینتیک واکنش آندهای تبدیل-type را تسریع و نرخ فوقبالای ذخیرهسازی سدیم را ممکن میکند.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a universal spin-polarization-engineered antibonding-orbital modulation paradigm to weaken robust M─S bonds, overcoming intrinsic kinetic barriers in conversion anodes. Magnetic Mn doping induces a low-to-high spin transition, boosting antibonding electron occupancy. The resulting Mn-FeS₂/CoS₂ anode achieves 300 mAh g⁻¹ at 120 A g⁻¹ and 13,000-cycle stability, validating a general strategy for ultrahigh-rate sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · conversion anode · spin polarization · antibonding orbital · ultrahigh rate
